say: Kwafi watts daga alamar kowace injin kuma ƙara su. Injin Chiamaka, ƙarfe, kwararan fitila, fanfo da caja suna zuwa watts 2,300.

panel.heading: Yi aiki da abin da kayan aikin ku ke zana
items: Lissafin kowane inji da watts ɗin sa daga alamar
Ƙara su: wannan shine jimlar nauyin ku
A halin yanzu a cikin amps = watts / 230
Ƙara tazarar kashi 25% don farawa
Generator VA = watts / 0.8

say: Abubuwan da ake samar da kayan aiki shine 230 volts, don haka raba watts da 230 don samun amps. Wato 10 amps.

say: Wasu dokoki suna kare mutane da dukiyoyi, don haka ba za su taɓa zama na zaɓi ba. Rubuta su a shafi ɗaya kuma sanya shi a bango.
Ci gaba da fitowa fili. Kada a bar zafi ba tare da kula ba. A kiyaye alamomin sinadarai, kada a cikin kwalabe na abin sha. Bayar da hadura lokaci guda. Kashe kuma kulle.
